tools.name: get_agency
tools.description: Retrieve a listed agency using an ID returned by search_agencies. Returns services, documented offices, contact details, editorial and customer ratings, and website findings such as pricing where available. Missing fields are unknown. Website findings may be incomplete or outdated.
